newsitem.title: USA: Key US lawmakers want Brownfields in Superfund law.
newsitem.headline: Key US lawmakers want Brownfields in Superfund law.

text.p: Key Republican lawmakers said Thursday that provisions on reclaiming urban sites that were contaminated with toxic waste should be kept in comprehensive Superfund legislation.

Senate Environment Committee Chairman John Chafee of Rhode Island and Rep. Mike Oxley of Ohio, who chairs the House Commerce Finance and Hazardous Materials subcommittee, both said so-called "brownfields" provisions should not be treated in legislation separately from the full hazardous waste clean-up bill.
"If you start peeling off these provisions, then attention to Superfund will diminish," said Chafee, who spoke at an environmental conference along with Oxley.
Oxley said negotiations on Superfund "will be more constructive if we don't have the distraction of a Brownfields-only bill."
